name: Suspension Row
steps: Face the anchor and grasp both handles with your palms facing each other.
Walk your feet forward and lean back until your arms are straight and the straps are taut.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes tightly so your torso and legs form a single rigid line.
Pull your chest smoothly up toward the handles by driving your elbows back close to your ribs and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower your body slowly back to full arm extension without letting your hips drop.
tips: Keep tension on the straps throughout every repetition without bouncing at the bottom.
Step your feet closer to the anchor for more resistance or farther back to make the row easier.
